results.question: which meetup spot got the most new listings in spring 2026?
results.sql:
SELECT ms.name AS meetup_spot,
       COUNT(*) AS new_listings
FROM nlq.listings_all la
JOIN nlq.calendar c ON c.day = la.listed_on
JOIN nlq.meetup_spots ms ON ms.spot_id = la.spot_id
WHERE c.semester = 'Spring'
  AND c.year = 2026
GROUP BY ms.name
ORDER BY new_listings DESC
LIMIT 1;
results.answer: Snell Library had the most new listings in Spring 2026, with 489 listings.

results.question: what share of all listings ever posted were offered for rent?
results.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_listings,
       SUM(CASE WHEN is_for_rent THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rent_offered,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN is_for_rent THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS rent_share_percent
FROM nlq.listings_all;
results.answer: Across all time, 12,947 listings have been posted, and 3,231 of them were offered for rent, which is 24.96% of the total.

results.question: for each category, how many days on average does it take an item to sell?
results.sql:
SELECT
  la.category,
  ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM d.completed_at - la.listed_at)) / 86400, 2) AS avg_days_to_sell
FROM nlq.listings_all la
JOIN nlq.deals d ON d.item_id = la.item_id
WHERE d.deal_type = 'sale'
  AND d.status = 'completed'
GROUP BY la.category
ORDER BY avg_days_to_sell;
results.answer: Across the nine categories, the average time to sell an item ranges from 11.20 days for bikes_transport up to 12.08 days for other. The other categories have: clothing 11.32 days, dorm_essentials 11.39 days, electronics 11.40 days, kitchen 11.49 days, textbooks and sports_outdoors both 11.56 days, and furniture 11.61 days.

results.question: average rating buyers give sellers, by item category
results.sql:
SELECT c.label AS category,
       ROUND(AVG(r.rating)::numeric, 2) AS avg_rating
FROM nlq.reviews r
JOIN nlq.deals d ON r.deal_id = d.deal_id
JOIN nlq.listings_all l ON d.item_id = l.item_id
JOIN nlq.categories c ON l.category = c.category
WHERE r.reviewer_role = 'buyer'
GROUP BY c.label
ORDER BY avg_rating DESC;
results.answer: The figures cover all time. Buyers rate sellers highest for Bikes & transport at 4.31, with Furniture close behind at 4.30. In total, nine categories are shown, with the lowest average rating being 4.24 for Textbooks.

results.question: what share of conversations led to a request, by meetup spot?
results.sql:
SELECT ms.name AS meetup_spot,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN c.led_to_request THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS request_share_percent,
       COUNT(*) AS total_conversations
FROM nlq.conversations c
JOIN nlq.listings_all la ON la.item_id = c.item_id
JOIN nlq.meetup_spots ms ON ms.spot_id = la.spot_id
GROUP BY ms.name
ORDER BY request_share_percent DESC;
results.answer: All time, there are seven meetup spots. The highest request share is at Marino Recreation Center, where 63.61% of its 2,248 conversations led to a request. The other spots range from 61.45% to 63.55%: West Village 63.55% (2,977), International Village 63.00% (3,557), Fenway (off campus) 62.91% (1,011), Mission Hill (off campus) 62.41% (1,527), Snell Library 62.30% (5,554), and Curry Student Center 61.45% (4,597).

results.question: late-return rate for rentals due during finals compared with rentals due during regular classes
results.sql:
SELECT c.period as period,
       COUNT(*) as total_rentals,
       SUM(CASE WHEN d.returned_late THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as late_returns,
       ROUND(AVG(d.returned_late::int)::numeric, 2) as late_return_rate
FROM nlq.deals d
JOIN nlq.calendar c ON d.rental_due_date = c.day
WHERE d.deal_type = 'rental'
  AND d.rental_returned_at IS NOT NULL
  AND c.period IN ('finals', 'classes')
GROUP BY c.period;
results.answer: Rentals due during finals had a late‑return rate of 0.19, while those due during regular classes had a rate of 0.20 (based on 134 rentals in finals and 2,742 rentals in classes).
